name: DropIndicator
purpose: Insertion marker shown while a drag is over a valid drop target: a line with a dot before or after a task row, a line at the list root, or a bar on a tab divider and at the end drop zone.
base: none (custom; shadcn has no drag-and-drop indicator)

values.when: Horizontal h-0.5 line with a dot at the left end, placed before (top) or after (bottom) a task row.
Same line, shown at the list root while the pointer is over blank space (rootDropOver).
Vertical bar h-6 w-1 rounded-full, shown in the tab strip on a tab divider or at the trailing end drop zone (B's placement end).

props.name: visible
props.description: Shown while a drag is over the target.

role: none (presentational, aria-hidden); the drop result is announced by the target
keyboard: None. Drag is pointer only; a keyboard move needs a separate path (open).
platform: Same on web and desktop; drag and drop works in both.
open: Colour conflict: both designs use accent for every drop cue (accent-500 and bg-accent-500). The decisions reserve accent blue for primary action and selection, so a drop cue needs its own non-accent token, which the decisions do not define. Root and row lines are count 0 in any recorded tree. The tab target covers the drop state of the list tab divider, hairline and trailing tab divider, end drop zone. B's orientation and placement axes are folded into target and edge (same looks; A's target axis keeps the visible row and tab difference).
